user_goal: Make a fragrance product page feel product-led, luxurious and trustworthy, with roughly 70 percent visual evidence and 30 percent text in primary surfaces.
visual_signature: A fragrance object studied like an archival gallery piece: warm paper, quiet aubergine ink, large deliberate photography, small factual annotations and a restrained buying desk.

primary_frame.media_behavior: normal document flow gallery; never sticky
primary_frame.buying_desk_behavior: may be sticky only inside the bounded primary-frame parent; must stop before story section

gallery_roles: 05 optional packaging / context image when source truth permits
composition.story_frame: image-led editorial band with concise scent copy plus notes/house proof; visual area should remain >= 60 percent where a supporting image exists
composition.related_frame: three restrained cards with consistent aspect ratio; related media must never be taller or visually louder than the main PDP gallery

content_rules.single_size: render as factual format text, never a selectable control
content_rules.trial_microcopy: Build a trio of 3 scents to compare.
content_rules.prototype_truth: keep honest but move to a low-disruption utility disclosure; do not place stock-count/prototype language beside the price as if it were retail inventory
content_rules.language: English-first within V4 PDP until a deliberate site-wide localization phase; do not mix a Vietnamese long description into an otherwise English product composition

media_rules.product_identity: Do not present visibly different bottle designs as if they were the same fictional SKU.
media_rules.same_source_crops: Deliberate crops of the same verified product image may create cap, glass, label and shoulder studies when each crop has a distinct role.
media_rules.atmosphere: Supporting botanical/material imagery must be labelled/positioned as olfactive or material context rather than another packshot of the SKU.
media_rules.stock_restriction: No branded third-party bottle may masquerade as a fictional Violet maison product.
media_rules.delivery: all primary media must decode before visual evidence is captured
media_rules.focal_gate: actual crop must be inspected at every declared desktop viewport

interaction_rules.trio: trial CTA updates localStorage and visible state without claiming fulfillment
interaction_rules.cart: full-bottle CTA keeps existing browser-local cart behavior
interaction_rules.sticky: only the compact buying desk may be sticky; sticky box must remain geometrically contained by its parent and cannot intersect story/related sections

qa_gates.geometric_overlap: zero intersections between sticky/fixed PDP surfaces and story/related content at every captured scroll state

do_not: do not solve the overlap with z-index masking
do not keep one giant image and add decorative text around it
do not use unrelated perfume bottle photography as alternate views of Violette 03
do not make the prototype disclaimer the strongest copy near purchase
do not call a stitched full-page screenshot sufficient proof for sticky-scroll behavior
